instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, find customer support contact information for statement inquiries and save it in a text document named statement_support_contact.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for customer support contact information for statement inquiries.
Open a relevant bank, utility provider, or service provider support page.
Find the customer support contact information.
Type the company name and customer support contact details into the document.
Save the file as statement_support_contact.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
